summary: Store official Go checkpoints in repo-local .go state
description: Make checkpoints a first-class go-workflow-stack capability. Introduce a versioned, validated checkpoint record stored under .go/checkpoints/, plus supported CLI write/read/list behavior. A checkpoint must point to canonical .go tasks, runs, evidence and git state rather than duplicate them; it must record the continuation objective, current/remaining state, exact safe resume command and redaction status. Preserve the existing managed run-state and release/deployment checkpoints as their own authoritative channels, and prove legacy run-state remains compatible. Do not write a generic CHECKPOINT.md or any vault/global state.
acceptance: A supported Go CLI checkpoint command writes a schema-versioned JSON record only below .go/checkpoints/ and can list/read the record by stable identity.

Each record has explicit repository/task-or-run identity, creation time, continuation objective, canonical references for git/.go evidence, remaining work, a concrete safe resume command, and a redaction verdict; it never copies secrets or creates a parallel task/decision source of truth.

Checkpoint creation validates the repo-local .go contract and rejects traversal, arbitrary output paths, malformed records, missing referenced local task/run artifacts, and a resume command that is not bound to the checkpoint identity.

Existing managed run-state, publication and deployment checkpoints retain their paths, schemas and read/resume behavior; new general checkpoints reference them where relevant rather than replacing or mutating them.
Behavioral tests cover creation, deterministic list/read, invalid or unsafe inputs, redaction scanning, and resume compatibility alongside the existing managed-run regression suite.
